description: Source code for Broadcom WL support module providing unified SSB/BCMA handling, including driver registration, callback setup, and bus type management.

methods.name: wl_glue_ssb_probe
methods.description: Probes and attaches an SSB device.

methods.name: wl_glue_bcma_probe
methods.description: Probes and attaches a BCMA device.

methods.name: wl_glue_set_attach_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for device attachment.

methods.name: wl_glue_set_remove_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback for device removal.

methods.name: wl_glue_register
methods.description: Registers the driver based on active bus type.

methods.name: wl_glue_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the driver based on active bus type.

methods.name: wl_glue_get_dmadev
methods.description: Retrieves the DMA device associated with a device.

methods.name: wl_glue_init
methods.description: Initializes the module, determines bus type.

methods.name: wl_glue_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the module, unregisters driver if attached.
